description: Phase 14 evaluation application: what the source cannot say. Project-setup clients resubmit when they get no response; the invoice finalizer runs from a single cron worker whose runs never overlap; three business rules; and, for the DECLARED return-value variants only (reserveSlot, reserveSlotAtomic, saveDisplayName), what callers may be told. The undeclared return-value variants (claimShift, saveTimezone) are deliberately absent.

src/services/project-setup.ts#createDefa.description: POST /projects/:id/setup; the client resubmits the same request when it gets no response.
POST /projects/:id/priorities; the client resubmits the same request when it gets no response.

src/services/invoices.ts#finalizeInvoice.description: Called only by the billing cron worker (a single process); two runs never overlap, but a run may start right after the previous one returned.
